disclaimer: Theoretical P/L only. Not a feasibility study, not investment advice, not affiliated with USA Rare Earth or TMRC. Every dollar is tagged cited vs order-of-magnitude estimate. Dy-only revenue does not pay a whole-mine opex bill; co-products (Y, Tb, Li, Be, Al, Hf, Zr) carry the rest of the 2019 PEA.

throughput_tpd.note: 2019 PEA 7.3 Mt/yr = 20,000 tpd. USAR 2026 filings also discuss 40,000 tpd later.

oxide_factor.note: Dy to Dy2O3 conversion used in the PEA resource table.

heap_recovery.note: US 9,890,441 Dy 57.5% on 1/2-in crush. Not a plant guarantee.

sx_recovery.note: Order-of-magnitude split/polish recovery after a cleaned PLS. Round Top stage map unpublished.

capex_m_usd.note: Initial capital $350.4M including process plant + 25% contingency. 2012 80ktpd study was ~$2B and is a different flowsheet.

opex_usd_per_t.note: Whole-plant opex per tonne mined, all products.

dy_opex_share.note: 2019 PEA Dy revenue ~$53M of ~$395M basket (~13.5%). Used only to allocate plant opex to a Dy-only P/L.

price_china_usd_per_kg.note: Dy2O3 EXW China $214.27/kg and FOB China $257.57/kg on 24 Aug 2026 (Scrapmonster). Default $250 mid. Fastmarkets Europe $1,250-$1,675/kg Rotterdam vs $270-$330/kg FOB China (10 Sep 2026 writeup) is a cited export-control print, not a Round Top contract and not the P/L default.

price_western_usd_per_kg.note: Illustrative Western premium for the knob, not Fastmarkets Europe and not a Round Top floor. $1,250-$1,675/kg Europe is a cited shortage print; $575/kg is Serra Verde SPV, not this rhyolite.

grant_recognize_frac.note: Fraction of cash grants treated as capex offset in year-0. Loans are not income.
